name: Hillsborough
seo_title: Hillsborough Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 5 Events, 4 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Hillsborough, North Carolina for 2026: 5 family events, 4 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Hillsborough celebrates Christmas with a weekend of tree lighting and a lighted parade, a drive-through light show and a solstice lantern walk.
celebrates: Visit Hillsborough opens the season with the Jingle and Joy Weekend Tree Lighting on December 5, with a reading by Mrs. Claus, photos with Santa and a procession to the Historic Orange County Courthouse tree. The Chamber of Commerce presents the Light Up the Night holiday parade on December 6, opening with the Running of the Elves. Mangum Family Christmas Lights runs a free drive-through show with more than 100,000 lights from November 20, and the Hillsborough Arts Council holds a Solstice Lantern Walk with handmade lanterns on December 19. The Elfland festival in Efland fills the weekend of December 11 and 12.
lastyear: The Hillsborough Chamber's parade page still shows an earlier year in its title, but its text lists the 2026 parade on December 6, which this guide uses. The Town of Hillsborough and Visit Hillsborough also list slightly different tree lighting times for December 5, so families should arrive early. Mangum Family Christmas Lights announces its 2026 season on Facebook, starting November 20.
facts: The Visitors Center is at 150 East King Street and the Historic Orange County Courthouse at 104 East King Street. The parade runs along Churton Street from Corbin Street to Margaret Lane, ending at Cameron Street. Mangum Family Christmas Lights is at 7510 Guess Road with more than 100,000 lights set to music on 90.3 FM. The Elfland festival is in nearby Efland.
trains: There is no train ride in Hillsborough itself. The closest family train outing we have verified is the North Carolina Transportation Museum in Spencer, in Rowan County, which offers 25-minute train rides. Our Raleigh guide covers the New Hope Valley Railway Santa Express, for families who want a full holiday train day out. Within town, the Light Up the Night parade and the Jingle and Joy procession are the nearest things to a holiday ride, since both move through downtown Hillsborough.
train_links: Admission from $10, or $20 with a 25-minute train ride, at the old Spencer Shops in Spencer.
traditions: Reading with Mrs. Claus, photos with Santa and a procession to the courthouse tree on December 5.

A free drive-through light show with more than 100,000 lights set to music on 90.3 FM.
A handmade lantern walk and market held by the Hillsborough Arts Council on December 19.
Santa's workshop, hayrides and photo scenes in Efland on December 11 and 12.
kidfact: At the Elfland Christmas Festival, photo scenes include A Christmas Story, Charlie Brown and The Grinch.
faq: What Christmas events can kids enjoy in Hillsborough?

Families can attend the Jingle and Joy tree lighting, watch the Light Up the Night parade, drive through Mangum Family Christmas Lights, carry a lantern at the Solstice Walk or visit the Elfland festival in Efland. Each listing links to the host's page for dates and prices.
Is the Hillsborough Christmas parade free?

Yes. The Light Up the Night parade is free to watch. It runs on Sunday, December 6, 2026, from 4 to 6:30 pm along Churton Street, and the Running of the Elves kicks it off at 4 pm. Food vendors set up in the Chamber lot.
Are there free Christmas lights in Hillsborough?

Yes. Mangum Family Christmas Lights is a free drive-through show on Guess Road with more than 100,000 lights set to music on 90.3 FM. It opens at 5:30 pm, runs through December 31, 2026, and the host announces any changes or closures on its Facebook page.
Where can children meet Santa in Hillsborough?

Santa is at the Jingle and Joy Weekend on December 5 for free photos, with Mrs. Claus reading stories. Santa's workshop is also part of the Elfland Christmas Festival in nearby Efland on December 11 and 12, which charges admission starting at $5 per child.
